content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IFFCO Trainee Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IFFCO to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited (IFFCO) for its Aonla Unit located in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include various categories of Trainee such as Materials, Lab Assistant, I.T. Services, Fireman, Instrumentation, Chemical, along with Junior Steno, Rigger, and Welder.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for IFFCO Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 10 November 2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IFFCO Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by post, generally ranging from 18 to 27 years for general trainees, up to 28 years for Fireman, and up to 35 years for Welder and Rigger positions as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Required qualifications depend on the specific post, ranging from 10th Class pass, ITI, Diploma, BCA, and B.Sc. to Graduate or post graduate diplomas in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IFFCO Recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online application form for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IFFCO Trainee positions?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an online written test, an interview round, document verification, and a final medical fitness examination.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IFFCO recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official IFFCO careers portal by filling out the online application form and uploading required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary scale ranging from RS. 27,500 to RS. 64,000 per month as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to send a hard copy of the application form?
faq.answer: No, candidates are not required to submit a hard copy of the application form at this initial stage of the recruitment process.
